name: initialize-vm
description: Sets BEService (BattlEye) to auto-start and starts it -- see docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md's BattlEye section for why this is required per-VM.
arguments: -NoProfile -Command "Set-Service BEService -StartupType Automatic; Start-Service BEService; Get-Service BEService | Select-Object Name,Status,StartType | Format-Table"
